HINT_EXITPATH: Where EXIT in the In-Game Menu goes. Best left empty: EXIT goes to the browser, which starts your boot loader (FreeMcBoot, PS2BBL, OSDMenu or BIBLE) when one is installed, and RIPPS2 again with BOOT LOCK on, as at power on; with none, the PS2 browser. An ELF typed here is used only when the reset can load it (on a memory card or a FAT32 USB drive) and it is not RIPPS2 itself; anything else goes to the browser.
